d: We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Accounting Manager to oversee the financial operations of a growing café chain, and food & beverage distribution business in Oman. Reporting directly to the Managing Director, you will lead day-to-day accounting functions, inventory and cost control, VAT compliance, and financial reporting across multiple retail and production outlets.
q: li
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. Professional certifications (CMA, ACCA, CPA, or CA Inter) are a strong advantage.
li
Experience: Minimum 5–7 years of progressive accounting experience, including at least 2 years in a managerial or senior supervisory role.
li
Industry Background: Prior experience in F&B, hospitality, retail, café chains, or FMCG manufacturing/roastery operations is strongly preferred.
li
Technical Skills: Strong proficiency in ERP/accounting software (e.g., Odoo, SAP, Tally, Zoho Books, or Oracle), POS integrations, and advanced MS Excel.
li
Local Knowledge: Solid understanding of Oman Tax Authority (OTA) VAT regulations and GCC financial compliance requirements.
li
Languages: Fluency in English is required.
r: Financial Operations & Reporting: Manage daily accounting operations, general ledger maintenance, accounts payable/receivable, bank reconciliations, and month-end/year-end closing processes. Prepare accurate monthly P&L statements, balance sheets, and cash flow reports for executive review.

F&B Costing & Inventory Control: Monitor Cost of Goods Sold (COGS), recipe/roastery production costing, raw material procurement, and stock variances across retail branches and central kitchen/roastery operations.
Tax & Regulatory Compliance: Ensure timely and accurate Oman VAT filings, corporate tax compliance, and adherence to local labor and commercial accounting standards.
Budgeting & Cash Flow Management: Assist the Managing Director in preparing annual budgets, financial forecasts, and working capital plans to support outlet expansion and operational efficiency.
Audit & Internal Controls: Implement strong internal financial controls, conduct regular branch cash and POS reconciliations, and coordinate with external auditors during annual audits.
Team Supervision: Supervise and mentor junior accounting staff, ensuring accuracy, accountability, and timely execution of financial tasks.

d: Job Summary: Responsible for leading the organization's financial strategy, governance, risk management, treasury operations, and financial performance. The CFO will partner with the CEO and Board of Directors to drive sustainable growth, profitability, operational excellence, and regulatory compliance.
q: li
Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.
li
MBA preferred; CPA, CA, ACCA, CMA, or CFA highly preferred.
li
Minimum 15 years of progressive finance leadership experience, including 7 years in a senior role within financial services.
li
Proven expertise in global remittances, money exchange, FX trading, gold and bullion trading, treasury, liquidity management, and payments.
li
Experience dealing with central banks, regulators, correspondent banks, and external auditors.
li
Strong knowledge of IFRS, corporate finance, risk management, and regulatory compliance.
p
Note: We thank all applicants for their interest, however only those candidates who are shortlisted will be contacted
r: Develop and execute financial strategies aligned with business objectives.
Advise the CEO and Board on financial performance, planning, growth, investments, and expansion opportunities.
Oversee accounting, budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, and performance management.
Ensure accurate financial statements, strong internal controls, and financial governance.
Manage treasury operations, liquidity, cash flow, capital allocation, and banking relationships.
Implement funding and hedging strategies to mitigate currency and commodity risks.
Remittance, Money Exchange, Gold & FX Operations
Oversee financial performance, profitability, pricing, and liquidity across remittance, money exchange, FX, and bullion trading operations.
Manage trading risks, transaction valuation, financial reporting, and related business development initiatives.
Establish risk management frameworks and ensure compliance with AML, KYC, CTF, sanctions screening, and regulatory requirements.
Liaise with regulators, central banks, and auditors, overseeing audit activities and corrective actions.
Lead finance, treasury, and accounting teams, fostering accountability and continuous improvement.
Maintain relationships with banks, regulators, investors, and business partners, and present financial recommendations to the Board.
